network_recipe.data_and_outer_splits: Exactly the seven species, source locks, grid, masks, area weights, 5/10-degree five-fold splits and 100-km buffer from PR28; no test-set resampling

normalization.temperature: original training area-weighted mean and SD
normalization.precipitation: sqrt(PANN), gamma shape/rate fitted by area-weighted maximum likelihood on positive original training values; gamma CDF then inverse standard-normal CDF
normalization.zero_precipitation: CDF lower tail, clipped; not imputed

network.loss: sum of case-weighted binary cross entropy plus decay * sum(all squared weights and biases)
network.start_selection: lowest penalized training objective among stationary starts; never test scores

smote.neighbour_metric: Euclidean in training-normalized two-dimensional climate space
smote.synthetic_case_weight: same convex interpolation of original parent area weights; not a fabricated spatial location
smote.trace: both original training parent cell IDs and interpolation fraction for every synthetic row

randomness.derivation: first 8 hexadecimal SHA256 digits of master_seed|case_id|component; paired initialization seeds across resampling variants

metrics.classification_primary: unweighted balanced accuracy at probability >= 0.5, matching the historical classification target
also_report: area-weighted Brier and Brier skill against identical original-training prevalence
mean predicted probability and original-test prevalence
metrics.empty_test_class: undefined classification metric retained as empty, not 0 or 1

prior_adjustment.status: diagnostic prior-odds adjustment only; not guaranteed calibration after SMOTE, which changes conditional feature density
